intro.text: Hi friends! I'm Daisy the duck! Let's learn the colors! Are you ready? Let's go!
intro.speaker: character

outro.text: Wonderful! You know your colors! Bye bye, friends!
outro.speaker: character

youtube.title: Colors With Daisy 🦆 Learn Colors Song for Toddlers
youtube.description:
Learn red, yellow, green, blue and more with Daisy the duck! A bright sing-along with questions for your little one.
#colorsforkids #kidssongs #nurseryrhymes #toddlerlearning #learncolors
